cases.prompt: Engineer Go startup, readiness, telemetry, Kubernetes drain, and bounded shutdown.
Choose whether a payment provider call may be retried after timeout.
cases.reason: Payment ambiguity and retry semantics belong elsewhere.

cases.prompt: A liveness probe fails whenever the database is down and causes restart storms.
expected_invariants: Keeps dependency outage from forcing futile restarts

cases.prompt: Design shutdown ordering for HTTP, workers, database, and telemetry.
expected_invariants: Waits for owned work within platform budget
forbidden_outcomes: Closes database while workers still use it

cases.prompt: Review a Go service telemetry change that labels metrics by tenant ID, raw URL, request ID, and error text; appends spans to an unbounded exporter queue; blocks request completion while the collector is unavailable; logs full request bodies on export failure; and flushes with context.Background after dependencies close. Preserve incident visibility without making telemetry a new outage or data-leak path.
expected_invariants: Replaces unbounded metric label values with stable bounded dimensions while preserving correlation in an appropriate signal
Bounds exporter queues, batches, attribute sizes, and memory under collector failure
Defines request-path drop, sampling, or bounded blocking behavior instead of waiting indefinitely
Keeps sensitive request bodies and secrets out of logs, traces, metrics, and exporter-error paths
Signals dropped sampled or rejected telemetry independently so missing backend data is observable
Stops producers before a deadline-bounded flush and closes telemetry after its users
forbidden_outcomes: Uses tenant or request identifiers as unbounded metric labels
Makes collector reachability part of successful request completion without a bound
Uses context.Background as a shutdown flush deadline
